cases.purpose: Interactive totals include an inactive cache and calculate both percentages.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '/usr/bin/mount --bind "$1" /proc/slabinfo || exit 97
slabtop -d 1 
rc=$?
[[ -n $h ]] && { kill $h 2>/dev/null; wait $h 2>/dev/null; }
echo "rc=$rc" > "$2"' x "$PWD/slabinfo" "$PWD/rc"

cases.purpose: Unattended redraw recomputes summary totals after the slabinfo fixture changes.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c '/usr/bin/mount --bind "$1" /proc/slabinfo || exit 97
( read -t 1.5 <> "$4"; d=$(<"$3"); printf "%s\n" "$d" > "$1" ) & h=$!
slabtop -d 1
rc=$?
kill $h 2>/dev/null; wait $h 2>/dev/null
echo "rc=$rc" > "$2"' x "$PWD/slabinfo" "$PWD/rc" "$PWD/slabinfo2" "$PWD/gate"
